name: Diego Guevara
headline: Business thinking.
intro: I study business and information systems at NJIT and build software for useful work.
availability: Exploring internships in business and technology.
about: I’m drawn to the space between a problem and the people experiencing it. I want to understand how work gets done, ask better questions, and build solutions that are clear and useful.
aboutDetail: At NJIT, I study business and information systems while supporting University Advancement operations. That work led me to build ZipHeatMap for a department need. I also contribute to chapter technology work through ALPFA NJIT and explore practical software, data, and product roles.

experience.title: Department Assistant
experience.summary: I maintain and check database records, investigate discrepancies, and support document, event, and office workflows. I developed ZipHeatMap to show donor concentration by ZIP code and make the geographic pattern easier to see and present to department leadership.

experience.title: Poll Worker / Election Administrator
experience.summary: I prepared voting equipment, verified voter records, trained staff on procedures, and escalated operational issues through established channels.

credentialsAndInvolvement.title: ALPFA NJIT
credentialsAndInvolvement.description: IT Committee member and intramural team captain; contributor to chapter app work.

credentialsAndInvolvement.title: NJIT Legacy Leaders
credentialsAndInvolvement.description: Volunteered at Student-Alumni Service Day in support of the Newark community.

professionalFocus: I’m exploring forward-deployed AI, UI/UX, and technical product roles.
